title: The procedure-dependent development of hemothorax in thoracic surgery.
summary: Postoperative chest hemorrhage can occur. This bleeding is often associated with prolonged hospital stays and/or increased mortality. However, clinically relevant data on this topic are lacking. The aim of this study is to determine the frequency of postoperative chest hemorrhage in relation to surgical technique, to ascertain how often such bleeding occurs, to describe the severity of such bleeding, to identify risk factors, and to track the course of the bleeding and the patient's progress on the ward. For this purpose, data will be extracted from the hospital's internal software between 2005 and 2025.

interventions.name:
Data is being collected retrospectively from the Department of Thoracic Surgery at the University Hospital RWTH Aachen for the period 2005–2025. The hospital's internal information system, MEDICO, is being used as the data pool.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

Patients who presented with a postoperative hemothorax. (J94.2)
Exclusion criteria:
Traumatic hemothorax (S27.1/S27.2)
